ready1_open_rewrite.title: GeoSQA open-ended question (1)
ready1_open_rewrite.rewritten_question_text: The water resource utilization rate refers to the ratio of water use in a river basin or region to the available amount of water resources. Internationally, it is generally believed that the limit for reasonable development of a river is a water resource utilization rate of 40%. The following figure is a schematic diagram of the development and utilization rates of water resources in some regions of China. According to the material and <image1>, what characteristic do the local rivers have that is one major reason for the lack of water resources in the Hexi Corridor?
ready1_open_rewrite.expected_answer: The river runoff is relatively small
